subject: Film & Cinema
title: Quentin Tarantino: Cinema's Remix Artist
description: Learn Quentin Tarantino: Cinema's Remix Artist in one minute.

hook.text: Tarantino dropped out of school, worked in a video store, and became cinema's most quotable voice.

buildup.text: Pulp Fiction, Kill Bill, and Inglourious Basterds remix film history into something original.

discovery.text: His power lies in dialogue — characters talk and talk, and you can't stop listening.

twist.text: He's said he'll retire after ten films because directors get worse, not better.

climax.text: Love him or hate him, Tarantino made film knowledge itself a form of entertainment.

punchline.text: The video store clerk became the professor.

quiz.question: What is Tarantino's announced plan for his career?
